title: 2179. Remove Duplicate Elements Using Dynamic Memory Allocation
description:
sions
2179
. 
Remove Duplicate Elements Using Dynamic Memory Allocation
80
Hard
Problem Statement
Given an array of N integers, remove all duplicate elements while preserving the original order of the first occurrence.
You must use dynamic memory allocation and pointers to solve the problem.
Your program should:
Read N integers.
Dynamically allocate memory using 
malloc()
.
Pass the array address to a function named 
removeDuplicates()
.
Remove duplicate elements using pointer operations.
Return the updated size.
Print the resulting array.
Release dynamically allocated memory using 
free()
.
Input Description
First line contains N.
Second line contains N integers.
Constraints
1 ≤ N ≤ 10000
-10⁶ ≤ Array elements ≤ 10⁶
